name: mentorit-ad-1
business: mentor it: a Hebrew marketplace that matches people with the right mentor. A 4-question matching questionnaire (field, budget, online or in person, goal) produces a personal match report with a % score and an explanation of why each mentor fits. Full mentor profiles show what you get in the first session and a transparent hourly price. Mentors are manually verified. Browse all mentors with filters. Mentors can also join the platform.
audience: People looking for a mentor (career, entrepreneurship, relationships, finance, parenting, health)
